rules.message: A budget limit must be greater than zero.
Day of month must be between 1 and 31.
rules.check: const d = Number(row.day_of_month); return d >= 1 && d <= 31;

rules.message: Amount must be non-zero and the date no more than 1 day in the future.
rules.check: const amt = Number(row.amount); if (!amt) return 'Amount must be non-zero.'; const d = String(row.date || '').slice(0, 10); const limit = new Date(new Date(ctx.now()).getTime() + 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10); if (d > limit) return 'Date cannot be more than 1 day in the future.'; return true;
